sources.entry: quick-look-plugins - List of useful Quick Look plugins for developers
Quick Look plugins - List of useful Quick Look plugins for developers.

summary.one_liner: A curated list of Quick Look plugins for macOS that preview file types such as Markdown, JSON, archives, source code, videos, and app or installer packages in Finder.
summary.what_it_does: This is an awesome-style list of macOS Quick Look plugins, organized as one section per plugin with a short description and install method. Each entry says what file types it previews, for example plain text with unknown extensions (QLStephen), Markdown (QLMarkdown, FluxMarkdown, Markdown Preview), JSON (QuickLookJSON), archives and folders (BetterZipQL, Folder Preview), Apple installer packages (Suspicious Package), macOS apps (Apparency, ProvisionQL), and video (QLVideo). Some entries cover scientific or 3D formats such as PDB, mmCIF, XYZ (Burrete) and 3MF models (Preview3MF). The install section gives Homebrew commands and manual steps, including a note on removing the quarantine attribute on Catalina and later. Several entries are paid apps sold on the App Store or website.
use_cases: preview JSON files without opening an editor
preview app or iOS provisioning information
preview video files and thumbnails in Finder
view scientific molecule files like PDB or XYZ
notable: Single curated list of many Quick Look plugins, grouped by plugin rather than by file type
Most entries can be installed with Homebrew, with a manual download option for the rest
Includes a Catalina quarantine-attribute fix for plugins that fail to load
Marks which plugins are paid App Store purchases and which are free
caveats: Several listed plugins are paid (marked with a money symbol) and bought on the App Store or a website
Peek is described as abandoned and buggy, though still functional
SourceCodeSyntaxHighlight may overwrite other Quick Look plugins
The Catalina quarantine note implies some plugins will not work on newer macOS without the attribute removed
